title: H形フレームの油圧ショッププレス
description: 金属加工・車両整備工場の背景に置くH形ショッププレス。二本柱と床スキッド、固定高さの開いた作業台と二つのV溝ブロック、ラム外形、連続した二本の戻しばね、手動ポンプ/握り/曲線ホース、数値のない固定計器を造形。一式1点で加工材は含みません。荷重・油圧・復帰・計測や安全性を実装/検証した製造用設計ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.187 × 1.835 × 0.754 m、14,556三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An H-frame shop-press exterior for metalworking and vehicle-service backgrounds. It has twin uprights/floor skids, a fixed-height open work bed and two V-notched blocks, ram exterior, two continuous return springs, manual pump/handle/curved hose and a fixed unnumbered gauge. The complete assembly counts once and contains no workpiece. Load, hydraulic, return, measuring and safety performance are not implemented or validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.187 × 1.835 × 0.754 m; 14,556 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
